title: Runtime binding of one agent
description: Machine-local, gitignored state at $AGENT_FABRIC_STATE_DIR/agents/<login>/binding.json. The agent is the Linux login of the effective user, stamped by runtime/identity.py; everything else is an attribute bound to that agent for now. Renaming or moving a working copy, opening another project, or changing role never changes `agent`.

agent.description: Linux login. Written by identity.py from the effective uid, never by the caller.

host.description: Short hostname of the machine the binding was written on.

role.description: The role currently activated, an id from identities/roles/catalog.json.

project.description: Logical project id from projects/registry.json the role was activated for.

working_copy.description: Absolute path of the checkout in use when the binding was written. Context, not identity; machine-local by nature.

workspace.description: The directory whose .claude/ received the role's skills and commands.

installed.description: What the role activator copied into the workspace, so it can remove exactly that and nothing else.
